newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay carries record passengers at Easter.
newsitem.headline: Cathay carries record passengers at Easter.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited said that over the Easter holiday period it set a record for the number of passengers carried in a single day.

The airline reported 38,865 passengers were carried on March 27 on the airline's world-wide network with Kai Tak handling 19,422. The previous daily passenger record of 38,514 was set on February 25 last year.
Cathay has said it expects to carry a record 11 million passengers this year.
On March 29 Cathay set a new record high for seat kilometres of 165,990,940, a multiple of passenger numbers and the distance carried.

Cathay said five extra sectors were operated between March 21 and April 3 to cope with extra passengers with additional flights to Bangkok, Manila and Denpasar in Bali. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
